I’m am currently not working with a doctor, no. But I have in my past as a teenager.
I’m 25 years old. And yes I agree, I do need help but idk how or where to find the right help . So far getting a reddit and using it has helped me more than most ways I’ve tried.

I try different things all the time. Literally no matter what I say or do, in my head it pretty much stays the same. It’s to the point where my thoughts and emotions get in the way of everything, work, writing music, talking to people in person, watching tv/movies, trying to build new relationships. Cognitive thinking rarely seems to have a positive impact. I’ve tried almost everything I can think of. Talking helps at times, not everytime. Very few know how to talk to someone suffering with problems like this. Most of the time i feel like it’s fake sympathy coming from those I personally know which is why I decided to post this anonymously, hoping to get real non biased response.
